summary: @brcrandall always loved your blogs. Thx so much for being the first #ncte18 to add your blog to the feed. If you are feeling adventurous add webmentions https://brid.gy so other attendees can comment on your posts from their website.

body_html: @brcrandall always loved your blogs. Thx so much for being the first #ncte18 to add your blog to the feed. If you are feeling adventurous add webmentions https://brid.gy so other attendees can comment on your posts from their website.
